name: job-search-copilot
description: A local-first Codex copilot for evidence-grounded job search and application preparation.

interface.longDescription: A Chinese-first Codex plugin for career positioning, public opportunity research, evidence review, feedback loops, and application preparation without final-submit automation.
defaultPrompt: 上传简历，帮我先明确求职定位并确认目标岗位。
按我已确认的定位搜索并核验当前 Top 20 岗位。
使用 $run-job-search-loop 根据我的反馈重新搜索，并为选中的岗位准备申请材料。
